name: What factors determine the cost of pre-sale or turnover damage repairs?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of pre-sale or turnover damage repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary based on the extent of damage, square footage, and materials needed rather than a flat rate. Spot drywall patches and simple paint touch-ups cost significantly less than whole-room sheetrock replacement or re-tiling high-traffic entryways. A practical tradeoff to consider is comprehensive painting versus spot repairs; blending paint on aged, sun-faded walls can leave noticeable sheen differences, making a full wall or room coat a better investment for listing value. An on-site walkthrough allows for an accurate, itemized estimate covering labor and materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing depends on total square footage, material choices, and whether the job requires small spot patches or full-room drywall finishing and surface repainting.
